routes.label: Match each year with its percentage

question: In \(1960\) only \(5\%\) of the working adults in Carlin City worked at home. By \(1970\) the “at-home” work force had increased to \(8\%.\) In \(1980\) there were approximately \(15\%\) working at home, and in \(1990\) there were \(30\%.\) The graph that best illustrates this is
solution:
The correct graph must show all four percentages, so compare the height above each year with the vertical percentage scale. The required values are
\[
1960:5\%,\quad 1970:8\%,\quad 1980:15\%,\quad 1990:30\%.
\]
Graph A starts at \(10\%\), so it fails the first value. Graphs B and D show \(10\%\) in 1970 instead of \(8\%\). Graph C shows about \(25\%\) in 1980 instead of \(15\%\).

Graph E starts halfway between \(0\%\) and \(10\%\), rises to about \(8\%\), then reaches \(15\%\) and \(30\%\). It matches all four values, so the answer is \(\boxed{\text{E}}\).
